author: AGSDR Freeze Agent 3 — companion to agsdr_local_harness.json
policy: Seed sets S_1, S_2, S_4 frozen BEFORE first optimizer evaluation (successive fidelity). Final rank uses declared multi-seed mean, not per-seed cherry-pick. Seeds are ledger entries not ad-hoc choices per jomission/simulation/ledger.py:11-19 PRODUCTION_SEED_LEDGER 0..31.

seed_pool.pairing_scheme: paired_by_replicate per jomission/simulation/ledger.py:15 intact vs omission share seed, but AGSDR_LOCAL_CL1 generic branch uses seeds as independent realizations
seed_pool.deterministic_fold: seed ^ 0x9E3779B9 ^ sigma*1e6 (jomission/network/builder.py:228) + seed+7919 Poisson (builder.py:612) + seed ^0x9E3779B9 ^0xC018 E mixture (builder.py:1059)

S0_coarse.note: Single seed coarse elimination. Seed 0 fixed. Do NOT re-rank survivors by seed1 later. Survivors = 8 Pareto non-dominated hard-PASS.

S1_refine.selection_statistic: mean_{s in [0,1]} y(s); also report spread max-min; hard requires both seeds individually finite & no hyper>80/silence<0.5
S1_refine.alternative_stratified: If HPC allows better spread, may declare S_2=[7,19] non-adjacent pair instead, but must declare before S1 launch and record here — not post-hoc. Default is [0,1] for cheap reproducibility with C018 seed0/seed1 receipts (be9b96ab/cdac08).
S1_refine.output: trace S1: results/agsdr_local/S1/candidate_AGS_S1_0x_seed{0,1}.json x16 + per-candidate mean bar_2 json

S2_confirm.selection_statistic: mean_{s in [0,1,2,3]} y(s) with t3 95% CI; theta_star = argmin Pareto mean among 3; variance across seeds breaks ties (lower var wins)
S2_confirm.alternative_stratified: If variance estimate needs broader coverage, may declare S_4=[0,7,14,21] stratified before S2 launch; default [0,1,2,3] is sequential and matches ledger 0..31 linear provision. Any change requires new seeds artifact version, not silent edit.
S2_confirm.final_ledger_rule: theta_star mean_4 advances as GEN2_C019 single delta be9b96ab->new_hash; other 2 finalists and all earlier candidates remain as evidence artifacts, not ledger forks
S2_confirm.output: trace S2: results/agsdr_local/S2/candidate_AGS_S2_0x_seed{0..3}.json x12 + per-candidate mean_4 + jacobian_estimate.json dY_k/d theta_j

totals.anti_cherry_pick: Final selection on S2 mean_4 not on max seed nor seed0; S0 single-seed rank never overrides S1/S2 mean; eliminated candidates never reinstated; seeds frozen write-once

verification.ledger_hash_at_freeze: computed at seal time via jomission/qualification/ledger.py:139 ledger_sha256_16
verification.harness_link: manifests/agsdr_local_harness.json AGSDR_LOCAL_CL1_HARNESS_v1.0 must reference this seeds hash

citations.builder_seed_fold: jomission/network/builder.py:228 seed folding + 612 Poisson seed+7919 + 1059 E mixture permutation
citations.gates_B2_hard_vs_soft: jomission/qualification/gen2_gates.py:139-154 B2 + manifests/agsdr_local_objectives.json H05/H06/H12 hard protects P(CV) tail not mean
citations.harness: manifests/agsdr_local_harness.json seeds_fidelity_schedule successive fidelity N0 24x1 -> N1 8x2 -> N2 3x4
